shortDescription: Create, Delete, or Update CloudVision Portal Configlets.

options.name: configlet_filter
options.description: Filter to apply intended mode on a set of configlet. If not used, then module only uses ADD mode. configlet_filter list configlets that can be modified or deleted based on configlets entries.

options.name: configlets
options.description: List of configlets to managed on CVP server.

options.name: configlets_notes
options.description: Add a note to the configlets.

options.name: cvp_facts
options.description: Facts extracted from CVP servers using cv_facts module.

options.name: filter_mode
options.description: If loose, a match is when a configlet matches a substring of a configlet defined in the filter. If strict, a match is when a configlet exactly matches a configlet defined in the filter.

options.name: options
options.description: Implements the ability to create a sub-argument_spec, where the sub options of the top level argument are also validated using the attributes discussed in this section.

options.name: state
options.description: If absent, configlets will be removed from CVP if they are not bound to either a container or a device. If present, configlets will be created or updated.
